provenance.prompt: Purpose: four side-table appearances with one fixed side-table-v1 floor/support function. Reuse and adapt the pinned Kenney Furniture Kit 2.0 original GLB/DAE inputs, preserve the original opaque wood/metal material and actual support structure, bake original world transforms once and normalize the bottom-centred dimensions in metres, +Y up and +Z front. Round retains the original pedestal/braces/base and replaces the six-sided slab with an actual 48-segment .26m-radius closed circular slab. Cabinet is fixed, nested is two independent grounded tables, and low is the original elongated four-leg tie-frame table. Keep a real .30 x .22m top patch at Y=.5 with non-overlapping surrounding top geometry, no floating decal. Validate the actual imported GLB through the fixed data, generic support and independent solid/source geometry gates. Budget 2500 triangles/32 meshes/four materials. Record source, license, all recipe changes, deterministic exports and failures. Design: Preserve the original elongated rectangular slab, four legs and long lower tie frame; adapt the actual dimensions without replacing its structure with the cabinet or nested form.
limitations: Static furniture and fixed nested arrangement. No door or slide mechanism.
Actual source/geometry admission is CPU evidence. Runtime contact, copying, closed-process restoration, ordinary-device performance and visual acceptance need separate evidence.
